items.title: Statistical Guarantees for Consensus Clustering
items.abstract: This paper presents statistical guarantees for consensus clustering algorithms, providing theoretical foundations for ensemble clustering methods.

items.title: Towards Thermal-Aware Hadoop Clusters
items.abstract: This paper explores thermal-aware scheduling and resource management strategies for Hadoop clusters to improve energy efficiency and prevent thermal issues.

items.title: Towards Thermal-Efficient Hadoop Clusters through Scheduling
items.conference: IEEE International Conference on Internet of Things (iThings), GreenCom, CPSCom, and SmartData
items.abstract: This paper presents scheduling algorithms for Hadoop clusters that optimize thermal efficiency while maintaining performance.
